post_title: H1B pending but STEM OPT just approved - safe to withdraw?
concerns_or_questions_summary: F-1 student with STEM OPT just approved (valid until January 2028) and a current employer's pending H-1B change of status filed September 2025. Wants to move to a new E-Verify employer and is asking whether withdrawing the still-pending H-1B keeps F-1 status and the SEVIS record intact, and whether pending withdrawal is safer than post-approval withdrawal.
